messages:
dev_rachel: quick follow-up on mid-stream fallbacks: propose a lightweight epoch+checkpoint so edge can switch variants without re-emitting tokens. want simple semantics, low overhead.

omar_khan: agree. key goals: no duplicate emits, cheap checks, clear billing boundary.

dev_rachel: sketch: edge requests epoch flush -> upstream replies with Commit-Token + last-offset -> edge can switch for future fragments. fallback must accept commit-token or run in read-only degrade.

lee_ops: implementation notes: keep commit-token small (<=32B), token TTL ~30s, epoch request best-effort under load (fallback to degrade-mode if no ack).

vika_research: headers example:

```
X-Redwood-Stream-Epoch: 12
X-Redwood-Commit-Token: ct-12-0000beef
X-Redwood-Commit-Offset: 4123
X-Redwood-Downgrade-Mode: delta-compress|short-context|cache-prefix
Hedging-Safe: true|false
```

omar_khan: billing: include X-Redwood-Billing-Checkpoint: <commit_token> so billing only counts tokens after the checkpoint. avoids double-billing when fallback wins.

dev_rachel: state machine: ACTIVE -> EPOCH_REQUESTED -> EPOCH_ACKED -> SWITCH_PENDING -> SWITCHED. until SWITCHED, incumbent streams normally.

lee_ops: tests we need: stall->epoch->delta switch (verify no double emit), lost-ack recovery, fallback-variant-no-token->read-only path. I'll own infra tests.

vika_research: telemetry: emit stream_epoch.{requested,acked,switched} with tenant/stream/epoch/commit_token/offset/reason for triage. SDK: expose onEpochSwitch and trailer fields.

dev_rachel: security/side-effects: hedging across epochs only if Hedging-Safe: true. otherwise allow only non-duplicating degraded variants.

omar_khan: ok, action items: rachel write RFC follow-up, lee prototype epoch map + perf run, vika telemetry + SDK hooks, tests in CI.

ci-bot: added tests/stream-epoch (branch=feature/stream-epoch) @2854321032 :white_check_mark:
